meta.description: Securely tunnel this DeepSeek assistant web panel to your phone or any browser for remote control, anywhere.
meta.title: DshRemote

panel.aboutDesc: Securely tunnel this DeepSeek assistant web panel to your phone or any browser for remote control, anywhere.
panel.appOnceHint: This is a long-term pairing code: the app registers the device and saves its login, then reconnects without scanning. Scanning the one-time QR on the "Connect" tab only grants a 1-hour temporary session, not a persistent binding.
panel.appSubtitle: Scan once to pair; the app reconnects without scanning
panel.banEmpty: No banned IPs. Click "Ban" on a device to add.
panel.configAcctLoadFail: Official server unreachable, please try again later.
panel.configAcctLoggedOut: Signed out (tunnel will disconnect; sign in again to restore)
panel.configAcctOauthDone: Authorized — applying your account and dedicated port…
panel.configAcctOauthHint: Your browser will open the official site to sign in / register, then come back automatically
panel.configAcctOauthNetwork: Official server unreachable, please try again later.
panel.configAcctOauthOpenBrowser: Browser opened: sign in to your account on the site and click "Approve". If it did not open, use the button below.
panel.configAcctOauthOpenFail: Could not open your browser automatically — open the approval page via the link below.
panel.configAcctRestartFail: Signed in, but tunnel restart failed: press "Start" to launch it manually.
panel.configOfficialHint: Register / sign in to your official account — works out of the box
panel.configOfficialNote: Official server: sign in (or register) and a dedicated entry is assigned automatically — no server details to fill in.
panel.configSubtitle: Connect to the official server or your own frps server
panel.configTokenNote: Token is stored only in local browserctl_secrets.json (gitignored, never committed or uploaded).
panel.elevateHint: If antivirus blocked frpc.exe or permissions got in the way, retry with administrator rights below (Windows will show a UAC prompt).
panel.elevateStopHint: Stop did not take effect: these processes may be running as administrator.
panel.elevateStartTimeout: The gate (3080) was still not ready 45 seconds after elevated start; check browserctl_start.log and browserctl_fwd.log.
panel.elevateStopTimeout: The gate (3080) is still running after elevated stop; check browserctl_fwd.log.
panel.linkNote: Paired devices appear in the "Paired phones" section on the Devices tab and can be unpaired anytime; never share the pairing code with others.
panel.linkStep1: Open the official site above in the phone browser (sign-in optional; this entry never changes, no matter how ports rotate)
panel.linkStep2: On the computer, open the Connect tab and switch to the "Long-term" segment to show the pairing code (it rotates automatically after each scan)
panel.linkStep3: Scan it with the iPhone camera (not WeChat): the browser registers and binds the device, then opens the panel verification-free for 30 days
panel.linkStep4: On the panel page, tap Share → "Add to Home Screen" to keep the entry permanently; after the 30-day window, scan a fresh code to renew
panel.linkSubtitle: For devices without the app (iPhone / iPad): open the official site, then scan the long-term pairing code from the "App pairing" tab — one scan registers the device for 30 days of verification-free access; then "Add to Home Screen" to use it like an app. No PWA invite link needed.
panel.logEmpty: No events yet. Device verifications, kicks and 2FA toggles are recorded here.
panel.loginRequiredDesc: Using the official server requires signing in first; a dedicated entry is assigned after login. Tap below to sign in.
panel.msgEmptyFeed: No pushes yet. Once push is enabled on this PC, its notifications will be collected here.
panel.msgGuestHint: Showing public announcements; sign in to the official account to receive direct messages.
panel.noDevicesHint: Devices appear here after opening the panel via the QR link and passing the 2FA code; locally opened panels are not counted.
panel.pairedWebNote: {n} more web sessions (browser, not persistently bound) — see the Online / History sections above to kick them
panel.pairAppTempNote: Scanning this code with the app grants only a 1-hour temporary session; for long-term pairing switch to the "Long-term" segment above.
panel.pairExpired: Pairing expired — refresh to generate a new one
panel.pluginUpdDesc: You are on v{cur}; v{v} has been released with the latest fixes and features.
panel.pushComposerHint: The message pops up on the phone App and in this PC's notification centre
panel.pushDesc: Realtime push of security events — device connect / kick / blacklist / 2FA / pairing — plus system messages to your phone.
panel.pushEmpty: No pushes yet. Security events will appear here once push is enabled.
panel.pushEnabledHint: Master switch: receive push from this panel on your phone
panel.pushMsgTitlePh: Leave empty to show the message only
panel.pushSendOff: Push is off — message not sent
panel.pushTestBody: This is a test push from DSH Remote Assistant
panel.sdHint: How long a verified device stays trusted. Only affects sessions issued afterwards; to force all devices to re-verify now, use "Kick all devices" on the 2FA tab.
panel.sigCleared: Cleared {s} online sessions, {d} device keys, {g} unused pairing codes
panel.sigHealthBad: Gate not responding (tunnel or process may be stopped)
panel.sigRevokeAllText: This revokes every device's login sessions and signature keys, voids unused pairing codes and clears all device records. Every phone/browser must re-scan afterwards. Continue?
panel.sigConfirm: Confirm once more: all regular devices are on v1.0.55+ with keys bound? If this locks you out, come back here to switch it off (effective immediately).
panel.sigDedupeHint: {n} stale duplicate records: the extras will be purged (and revoked), keeping the newest/authorized one per device; same-name revoked records from different IPs count too
panel.sigDedupePart: Removed {ok}/{n}; the rest were only revoked (deletion needs the new gate + local panel)
panel.sigFail: Switch failed (host route not ready? needs DSH restart)
panel.sigHint: Criterion: "grace: unsigned request" stops appearing in the run log (events are throttled to 60s; close background phone browser tabs and wait a few minutes before judging).
panel.sigRdLock: {w}/{t} active devices have a bound key, {n} still missing; enabling now would lock them out on the boot page.
panel.sigRdNotReady: Not ready (some devices have no bound key)
panel.sigRevoked: Revoked; the device must re-pair or verify with a code
panel.sigRevokedKeep: Revoked; the device must re-pair or verify with a code (record kept; deleting it needs the local admin panel)
panel.sigSwitchHint: When enabled, requests without a valid device signature are rejected with 401 + onboarding page; devices holding a 30-day session but no bound key are refused.
panel.startTimeoutShort: The local gate (127.0.0.1:3080) was not ready within 30 seconds; check the log files in the kit folder.
panel.statusNoSecret: Tunnel not ready: click "Start control" below, QR appears in a few seconds
panel.statusReady: Tunnel ready — scan to open the panel
panel.statusTunnelBuilding: Tunnel is starting — the QR appears automatically in a few seconds (no need to click Start again)
panel.statusTunnelStarting: Tunnel starting; refresh the QR in a few seconds
panel.subtitle: Scan or copy the link to open this panel from any device
panel.sysHint: Sampled by the local gate, ~10s cache.
panel.ticketCopyContentDesc: Copy the redacted full text to the clipboard for pasting into a chat.
panel.ticketCopyFail: Copy failed — open the exported txt and copy manually.
panel.ticketExportHostOld: The plugin host is still the old version (this feature needs a full DSH restart). Quit DSH completely, reopen it, then try again.
panel.ticketExportNote: Logs are generated locally and never uploaded automatically; you decide what to upload on the web.
panel.ticketExportSubtitle: Export the local diagnostic log (auto-redacted), then choose where it goes.
panel.ticketNoContent: Log not generated yet — click "Export diagnostic logs" first.
panel.ticketOpenWebDesc: Recommended: sign in, submit the ticket on the web and upload this txt as a log file.
panel.ticketSaveOtherDesc: Keep another copy of this log in a folder you choose.
panel.ticketSavePathPh: Paste a full folder path, e.g. C:\Users\you\Documents
panel.totpAppHint: An authenticator app on the phone generates the codes; Microsoft Authenticator is recommended:
panel.totpHintShort: Devices must enter a 6-digit code to open the panel; 5 wrong tries lock for 15 minutes.
panel.updateApplyDone: Updated to v{v}; restart DSH to apply
panel.updateApplyTip: Downloads the official zip and overwrites this plugin folder (the tunnel stops first). Restart DSH to finish; works for extracted-folder installs only
panel.updateDownloadTip: Open the official zip direct link in your browser (about 6.4 MB) as a manual fallback
panel.updateGuideLocal: To update: download the new zip, extract it over the plugin folder ({dir}), then restart DSH. If the tunnel fails afterwards, run fix-antivirus.bat in the folder first
panel.updateGuidePackage: To update: run "{cmd}" in a terminal, then restart DSH
panel.updateGuideTestNote: (test copy: one-click update is disabled here — use the release tool to sync)
panel.updateIgnoreTip: Skip reminders for this version; newer releases will notify again
panel.updateRecheckTip: Query the official update source again (GitHub Release, mirrored hourly by the website server)
